notes.v-synonym-02: Dropped 'free of charge'; the clue is now 'borrowers' in the second clause, so 'rents' (also temporary, also returned) is a real trap. Level 1->2.
notes.v-synonym-04: 'composes' replaced by 'conforms' (needs 'to', means 'agree with rules'); consists/comprises/constitutes remain the test.
notes.v-family-01: Rewritten on confident/confidential/confiding/confided ('keep every detail strictly ___'); no overlap with g-pos-06 or any other item.
notes.v-collocation-07: fell short of the target; near-miss 'ran' (run short of = supply runs out), ruled out only by 'the target'. Medium.
notes.v-collocation-08: lodge a formal complaint; distractors house/host/board are all lodging verbs like 'lodge'. Hard.
notes.v-collocation-09: bear in mind that ...; near-misses take (into account) and carry (synonym of bear). Easy.
notes.v-synonym-07: abide by the safety rules vs comply/adhere/conform, all meaning 'obey'; the preposition 'by' decides. Medium.
notes.v-synonym-08: suspend production for two weeks ... resume; terminate/abandon/conclude are permanent. Medium.
notes.v-synonym-09: waive the cancellation fee; exempt/spare/relieve mean the same but take a person object. Hard.
notes.v-business-07: a deposit of 15 percent ... balance due upon delivery; near-miss 'rebate' (also a percentage of price). Medium.
notes.v-business-08: reconcile bank statements with the ledger and investigate discrepancies; near-miss 'consolidate ... with'. Hard.
notes.v-family-07: attentive to guests' needs vs attendant/attended/attending; 'attendant' tempts in a hotel stem. Medium.
notes.v-family-08: a complimentary copy of the book; near-misses complementary (spelling) and completed (completed copy of a form). Easy.
